---
title: "PANEL-E"
---
```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(mosaic)
library(ggformula)
```

```{r}
#| label: My Panel E data
E <-  read_csv(file = "data/panel_E.csv")
E
```

```{r}
skim(E)
```

```{r}
glimpse(E)
```

```{r}
E_mod <- E |> mutate(across(where(is.character),as.factor))
glimpse(E_mod)
```

```{r}
E_mod |> gf_bar(~`MBTI Type`, fill = ~Department)
```
```{r}
#| label: Chi-square_test
mosaic::xchisq.test(`MBTI Type` ~ Department, data = E_mod)
```
